tools.name: federal_register_search
tools.description: Search the US Federal Register (rules, proposed rules, notices, presidential documents) via the official API. Filters: agency slug, type, publication date range, open_for_comment. Returns comment deadlines, docket IDs and regulations.gov comment links. $0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.description: Federal rules currently under White House OIRA review (EO 12866) or that concluded review in the last 30 days, from reginfo.gov data refreshed daily.
